conclusions.thread_start_module_identified: nvoglv64.dll; start address only, not sampled instruction/stack
conclusions.cpu_counter_granularity: observed 15.625ms steps; cannot relabel old budget failures
conclusions.python_monotonic: Python 3.9 uses GetTickCount64, resolution 15.625ms; original gate kept
conclusions.no_gl_control: Vulkan/DX12 retained through child-local WGPU_BACKEND; actual adapter remains RTX 2060 Vulkan 560.94; fewer retained threads and lower process memory, no repeatable CPU/cycle reduction
conclusions.overlay: graphics-hook64.dll start-thread cycles observed 0; costs executed on GUI/presentation or other threads are not excluded
conclusions.next: Validate short periodic CPU-accounting bias using bounded owned reference workload and longer diagnostic windows; split main-thread call costs only with trustworthy timing

limitations: Native CPAL/WASAPI work outside own render remains unmeasured; callback wall is not full output-thread CPU
Cycles are not CPU time; frequency/scheduling/counter implementation may differ, even similar cycles do not prove equal runtime
Start modules do not identify currently running functions or all overlay costs; old exited processes cannot be retroactively mapped
Optional internal NtQueryInformationThread is dynamically resolved in tools only; failures remain unknown, never product dependency
Thread/process times are non-atomic, cycle gaps including negative preserved; retained handles may miss transient threads
Only local Windows 48kHz stereo F32/480 frames, low-level self-authored WAV, controlled GUI dispatch; no acoustic/cross-device/platform/pixel/standard 300s/file export acceptance
